in_sanskrit.name: Brahman
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Brahman (ब्रह्मन्) is the supreme cosmic power in Hinduism, the creator of the universe. It is the ultimate reality, consciousness, and the eternal, unchanging and infinite divine entity. It is also referred to as Parmatma, Parameshwar, and Param Brahma.

in_hindi.name: ब्रजेन
in_hindi.long_meaning: Brajen (ब्रजेन) is a name derived from Brahman (ब्रह्मन्), meaning 'God, supreme being'. The name Brajen signifies one who is the son of Brahman or is graced by God.

in_tamil.name: பிரஜேன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Brajen (பிரஜேன்) is a name of Tamil origin, derived from Brahman (பிரமஹம்), the supreme God in Hinduism. The name Brajen signifies one who is the son of Brahman or is graced by God.

in_telugu.name: బ్రజేన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Brajen (బ్రజేన్) is a name of Telugu origin, derived from Brahman (బ్రహ్మన్), the supreme God in Hinduism. The name Brajen signifies one who is the son of Brahman or is graced by God.

in_marathi.name: Brajen
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brajen हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Brajen is derived from the Sanskrit language, where 'Bra' stands for Brahma, the creator god, and 'Jen' signifies light. Thus, the name Brajen symbolizes the radiant light emanating from the creator god.
